verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs describe an Issues page where developers see and debug errors affecting the application, filterable by unhandled status and impacted users. Stack traces with suspect commits are explicitly listed. Release tracking is covered by the CLI's release and source-map management and by deploy notifications. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of regression detection (resolved issues reopening on new releases), documentation of how errors are grouped into issues, and independent hands-on corroboration of these specific features.
